Title: Still running long after a month? Declutter first
Description: A 15-minute weekly reset: one timed pass with a basket, a 4-week rotation for monthly safety checks, and what habit research says about missed weeks.

Title: Most systems can run MERV 13 if you change it often
Description: Check your furnace filter monthly, change 1-inch filters by 3 months, and learn why pressure drop, not MERV, decides if MERV 13 suits your system. Table inside.

Title: Wash cold, since roughly 90% of washer energy heats water
Description: Nine free habits ranked by the slice of the bill they attack, with the math: thermostat setbacks, a 120°F water heater, cold washes, and standby loads worth chasing.
Keywords: electric bill, heating and cooling costs, water and gas bills

Title: Mow before the grass hits 1.5x your mower setting
Description: Mow at the right height for your grass, leave the clippings, and fertilize once at the right time. Extension heights, dates, and bag math inside.

Title: Cable boxes: a median 8 W in standby, about $12 a year
Description: Each always-on watt costs about $1.50 a year at 17¢/kWh. Measured standby watts and dollars by device from Berkeley Lab, and where the real idle load hides.
